fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) declined approximately 26% from its early October high of $487, yet with October revenue growing 59.7% year-over-year and strong demand for leading-edge technology, it is valued at approximately 15.38x next year's earnings.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite AI monetization uncertainty and China export restrictions, TSMC's customers (Nvidia, AMD, Google, Amazon, etc.) continue to require advanced manufacturing capabilities, and even amid competitive chip design developments, order volume reductions at TSMC are not expected to result directly.
